shared_pipeline.capture: Analysis dispatcher selects custom analyzers only for exact lowercase .ts/.tsx/.py/.css/.scss/.md/.markdown/.ipynb extensions; others go through Lizard or fallback.
shared_pipeline.representation: API Node type collapses many AST/display origins to function; origin_type and synthetic classification are not preserved. Scope path uses name hierarchy, not a collision-resistant executable ID.
shared_pipeline.propagation: Most TS counters exist at file level only. Folder rollup skips ten TS/TSX counters; scope nodes do not inherit file metrics.
shared_pipeline.ui_ranking: All nonfolder nodes in current Explorer input; sum of selected metric/max over the mixed cohort; comment_density uses 1-value. Unsupported defaults enter as zero; top 50 can include zero-score nodes.
shared_pipeline.report_ranking: All nonfolder nodes; per-node weighted mean of positive-valued metrics after cohort max normalization. Zero-valued weights are omitted from the denominator. Path multipliers and relative priority bands follow.
shared_pipeline.cli_ranking: run.py creates a _custom weights dictionary from arbitrary --metric strings with equal weights; no numeric registry or direction validation. Thus even non-report API numeric fields can be requested, and unknown names can silently produce no results. Requesting a string-valued API field can cause float conversion failure.
shared_pipeline.display: 22 selector entries also drive treemap colors and modal metrics. Nonselector definitions do not automatically appear in the modal. Explorer accessors are not equivalent to visible column controls.
shared_pipeline.color: Most selected fields reuse [0,10,50] regardless of unit; comment density, TODO and nesting have custom domains; depth brightening changes color for equal values.
shared_pipeline.diagnostic_gaps: No per-metric capability, no support-aware eligible denominator, no source contribution spans for most counters, no stable semantic scope identity.
shared_pipeline.empirical_claims: No correlation, runtime, validity or usability measurements were performed.

declared_definition.name: loc
declared_definition.description: Lines of code excluding comments/blanks where available.

observed_semantics.file: Custom TS, Python, CSS and Markdown count nonblank source lines, including comment-only lines. Notebooks count nonblank cell source, not JSON or outputs. Failure/oversize fallback counts nonblank lines until the 32 MiB accounting cutoff; this can be a lower bound and is not a hard per-line read bound.
observed_semantics.function_or_display_scope: TS/Python/CSS/Markdown scopes usually use inclusive physical spans, including blanks/comments; synthetic imports count all import spans but point at one largest block; notebook cells use virtual nonblank lines. Lizard functions retain Lizard NLOC.
